test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b88a8e3e6f464b9f5659c2193de1d332d106252c4f9d88fabf66d0054d93a3b0.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first column elements shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately second and third column elements shifts in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b33077a328aeadab8ec1f3f6454220d03a12d8cb4064fdd1ad88f8ad54a59ec2.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element and bottom left corner element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately center left element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/041ea07649ce63e97161a14685268cacf036daadceaf88f306d7ae856fecf6ae.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c29f75881b872e7ae12c6b18cc09ae783a8d8cc22abff12921e26bca5f7b30f0.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efe60247c6ed1eee04bf9d43700dc896f6ebaf809c4785996222fd441013e0a3.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/164da86887002a096eb9d86e7b637f174f11a5fb349ffe218831fe6471d01693.png] '.
 
• Alternately third column elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d56eac690f61c3ce0c52cf92e8f864889ed87e811cd786fd65c6b7976971e34.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/786f5f9b228ae4bd1582778dfd92a331a31c23d75ed774ae33ee5690db22836f.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (3)’ is the correct answer.
